page.layout: One column of running text, with the catchword at the right below the last line. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: literis suis non minori eruditione qvàm suavitate conditis, me Romam cùm ju-bere posset, peramanter invitat, idqve iterari mihi per Eminentissimum Cardi-nalem Bichium procuravit, qvi me ab Eminentia tua studiosè commendatum humanissimè dicam & officiosissimè ex-cepit, itinerisqve sui comitem esse vo-luit. Ista me obseqvio tuo non devin-ciunt, Eminentissime Cardinalis, qvip-pe qvi benevolentiae tuae demonstratio-ne me tibi devinctum jamdudum habes, sed animum gratum & obseqviosum te-standi, qvanqvam maxime velim, o-mnem occasionem spemqve praeripiunt; non abs re ausim hac in causa usurpare S. Patriarchae Jacobi responsum, Patri, de prospero & tam prompto venationis successu, interroganti datum, voluntas Dei fuit, ut cito occurreret mihi, qvod volebam. Licet enim de me scriptisqve meis tam fausta conjicere, aut etiam co-gitare non auderem, effecit Deus, cujus χρειῶν νόῳ [illegible, ~5 letters] ἀνδρῶν, ut cito oc-curreret mihi, qvod volebam, audenter-qve

page.notes: The Greek phrase in the middle of the line (after "cujus") is only partly legible; the letters between νόῳ and ἀνδρῶν are marked illegible, and the first word is a best reading. The catchword "qve" stands below the last line at the right. The long s has been normalised to s, and the initial "svavitate" was corrected to "suavitate" on the u/v rule. Some hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens.
